notes.title: Future of World of Shadows - Stapleton
notes.content:
[h2]And we have World of Shadows...[/h2] 
The beloved game that took 4+ years to design.
I have already made news announcements of Card Battles and Heavenly Acres.
Talking about how I am going to improve their UI systems and so fourth.
To be honest, World of Shadows UI system is actually not as bad.
And it's because it is the least modified of the 3, lol.
Meaning I screwed them up it seems!
It is mainly because I integrated mouse into the mix.
World of Shadows does not utilize the mouse and therefore the UI design is straightforward.
This fact became obvious to me when Sit-Back Attack (a New IDLE RPG I am designing) started
to come to light.
This game only uses the MOUSE! And boy has that made designing UI much simplier.
But I have also learned much from this.

Enough getting side-tracked anyway.
World of Shadows future is like this...
- City of Atlantis will be added
- Haunted mansion will be added in Ba'terra
- Ultra Bosses will be added

That about sums it up.
This will receive the least of the updates of the 3.
But that is because this game (though retro and more outdated) is actually the most solid.

Thank you again for reading!
- Stapleton!

notes.title: World of Shadows is on SALE 50% OFF!
notes.content:
[h2]World of Shadows is on SALE 50% OFF![/h2]
This JRPG (the first of Stapleton's creations) is on sale for 50% off!
Get it while you can!

[h2]FAQ![/h2]
[b]- But isn't there a demo?[/b] Sadly no, but maybe in the future!
[b]- What is so special about World of Shadows?[/b] It has a good story, a farming system (though not nearly as well done as Heavenly Acres), a full card battle system, over 20 playable party members all with their own unique personalities, classes, and skills. And a lot of challenges!
[b]- What won't I like about it?[/b] To be honest probably the resolution. 
   - It is a retro game with retro resolution capabilities. It can easily be full screen and it still looks good 
       with full screen, but this is often a complaint..
   - Not much guidance in the game. Some people like this, some don't. Just a warning!

[h2]What is next for World of Shadows, Stapleton?[/h2]
- Sadly nothing as of yet. I am pretty content where it lays. Some plans of refinement are in the works, though!

[h3]Check out Heavenly Acres, Stapletons latest game out! It is 20% OFF and just released a month ago![/h3]
https://t.co/28WUm7e62i

Anyways I appreciate your interest in the game! Please contact Stapleton if you have any questions or concerns! Thanks!
- Stapleton!

notes.title: Big New Features Added!
notes.content:
Added TURBO MODE! Press F7 or Enable it in Menu: System, to double game speed! Great for exploring! Default Battles still proceed in normal speed.

Added TURN-BASED battles! For those of you that want a less stressful approach to the game there is now a setting in Menu: System that will enable turn-based battles. Now you can take your time deciding combat abilities without getting mauled!

Added in extra tutorials and hints to help your adventures go smoother!

-Thanks

notes.title: Controller Support Update!
notes.content:
Changed the way controller directions worked.
Movement both map and menu can now be used with only the analog or the D-Pad. The option can be changed in-game in System Options.
This simplifies things by allowing you to move on the map and use the menu with the same directional input!

However, recently launching the game directly from steam interfered with XInput and is causing some controller issues.
If you experience any of these please right click on the game in your library, go to properties, and browse local game files and launch it from there.
Until I get it straightened out!

Thanks
-Stapleton
